interpretation_challenges: All 8 U-slot primary passes are exact_zero_same_route (A/RAC1P and AB/RAC1P x 2 weightings x {D17, RD_TASK}): 0/12 non-trivial U clauses pass. On a1/a2 the U nominee IS D17 (witness fallback); on a0 both releases chose the H-only route H/mlp_120.

U nominee is a0-only: a1/a2 anchor estimates are exactly 0 and the equal-anchor mean divides the a0 effect by 3. Outer task point -0.00015 (U) / -0.00002 (PWGTP) against a -0.003 target; inner task was +0.0016 (worse than D17).

P nominee NM4_P is demonstrably adverse on the task guard (lower bound > +.001 vs D17 and RD_TASK, both weightings; point +0.0078/+0.0076). AB/SEX point -0.0040/-0.0031 is a trade, not dominance; a1 PWGTP AB/SEX has the wrong sign (+0.0008); a1 A/RAC1P and AB/RAC1P recovery rises by +0.0014 to +0.0023.

Strongest adverse secondary comparisons (points): NM4_P vs DET_SEL4 task +0.0080/+0.0072 with AB/SEX -0.0003/+0.0003 (the same-K deterministic selector reaches equal AB/SEX recovery much more cheaply); NM4_P vs T32_P task +0.0029/+0.0030 for AB/SEX -0.0012/-0.0010; NM4_P vs Q_HIST task +0.0088/+0.0079.
H-capability 4/4 reflects information already in T0/D17, not the new mechanism.

RD_PRIV and all ADV comparators collapsed to D17, so any "beats RD_PRIV/ADV" statement is vacuous; comparisons reduce to D17 and a near-D17 RD_TASK (tau at grid maximum; differs from D17 only on a2 for 0.29% of people).

Wording: no privacy guarantee (finite audit slate, conditional on fitted/selected objects, repeatedly used 2018 development data); do not call NM "used" for the U nominee (a0 NM1_U = T32_U, eta 0) or for NM4_P on a1/a2; "no route passed" is the correct headline.
